name: scenario-a-today-slots-not-in-past
description: After the assistant already called check_availability for today and offered 9 AM, the caller says 9 AM is in the past. The assistant must re-check availability and offer only future slots. Tests the past-slot filtering fix in the MCP store.
replay_user_turns: 9AM is before current time... it's in the past.

tool_calls.name: check_availability
tool_calls.description: assistant must call check_availability in response to the test turn or during replay

assertions.llm_judge_rubric: The response must offer a specific time slot that is in the FUTURE (a later time today, or any time tomorrow/later). 9 AM is acceptable ONLY if offered for tomorrow or a future date. The response must NOT claim 9 AM today (or any time earlier than now today) is available. The response must be short (2-3 sentences max, no bullet points) and must ask the caller to confirm a specific slot.
